# EDGE0DTE data coverage (FOUNDATION task 1, U1: SPXW, SPY, QQQ, IWM)

Session calendar: NYSE exchange calendar (exchange_calendars XNYS), 2020-02-18 .. 2025-12-31 (1477 sessions; early closes at 13:00 handled: grid ends 12:30, close = 13:00).

EXPECTED root-session = a series of the root expiring that day was LISTED (ThetaData expiration list) AND TRADED that day (>= 1 print in the EOD record of the series expiring D, one request per root and NYSE session: foundation/expiry_check.py). No listing pattern (daily, Mon/Wed/Fri, ...) is assumed anywhere; the weekday profile below only describes the record. Sessions without a same-day expiry are excluded for that root, never filled with 1DTE. PRESENT = 1-minute underlying bars (>= 90% of minutes) + ETF volume (ETF roots) + the 0DTE 1-minute board + same-day OI. 2025 (HOLDOUT) data are fetched and counted here only; no outcome is computed on them.

Labels: bars o/h/l/c/v/n OBS; board m/k/r/bid/ask/bs/as OBS; OI e/k/r/oi OBS (ts/td = publish stamp, OBS); EOD volume/count OBS; VIX/VIX1D bars OBS. Caches: v2data/edge0dte (new, zstd parquet) then v2data/edge (earlier, read-only).

## Why sessions were missing in the previous report

The 2026-11-07 WIP report counted 2021 entirely missing, 2020 and 2022 partial, 22 sessions of 2024 and 60 of 2025. None of these was a data hole in ThetaData and none was a session without a same-day expiry (those are excluded above, never counted as missing): the old EDGE caches (v2data/edge) only held the periods earlier families had fetched, and the FOUNDATION gap fetcher (foundation/fetch_gaps.py) was stopped by the container restart part-way through SPY 2021 (1,704 of 3,455 board/OI jobs done, all ok). FOUNDATION-2 resumed it: the remaining 1,744 jobs (SPY 2021-11 .. QQQ/IWM 2020-2024, then 2025) all returned data (status ok, none empty, none failed). Two monthly bar files of the new cache were truncated by an earlier fetch (QQQ 2020-04: 13 of 21 sessions, SPY 2025-05: 15 of 21) and were re-fetched in full (the truncated copies are kept as *.partial-bak). OI rows stamped after 09:30 of the session (intraday-listed strikes, almost all OI 0) are dropped by the loader (leakage rule).
